3.speaker: Gloria Tory
3.text: “I wanted to provide you with some quick updates on the current political situation.”

4.speaker: Gloria Tory
4.text: “The changes you ordered to the Supreme Court have now been implemented."

11.speaker: Gloria Tory
11.text: “The entire Court has been reshuffled. We're starting a new era."

12.speaker: Gloria Tory
12.text: “As you know, I've redoubled my focus on improving our public image."

13.speaker: Gloria Tory
13.text: “There's now a decision to be made."

14.speaker: Gloria Tory
14.text: “Our initial reports are showing that advertisement over television is becoming a very effective method. Especially among young people."

15.speaker: Gloria Tory
15.text: "Saying that the replaced members were furious would be an understatement.”

16.speaker: Gloria Tory
16.text: “I have consulted with a few advisors and we would like to put out a television campaign. We've already got Sordland's biggest ad agency on board for the job."

17.speaker: Gloria Tory
17.text: “For this, they will be given security clearance to come in and take photos and videos in the Maroon Palace. Specifically they want footage of the president working and posing.”

18.speaker: Gloria Tory
18.text: “The entirety of the Old Guard has been purged."

19.speaker: Gloria Tory
19.text: “This way the people can feel closer to their leader in their homes. What do you think?”

20.speaker: Player
20.text: “That sounds great. I always wanted to be a television star.”

21.speaker: Player
21.text: “It's a good plan. Let's do it.”

22.speaker: Player
22.text: “I won't allow regular citizens to come in here. What's next? Tourists roaming the Palace halls?"

23.speaker: Gloria Tory
23.text: “The changes you ordered to the Supreme Court have now been implemented."

24.speaker: Gloria Tory
24.text: “I'll note that down as a yes, then."

25.speaker: Gloria Tory
25.text: “But there isn't much they can do about it now that they've been stripped of power.”

27.speaker: Gloria Tory
27.text: “Of course, the members we replaced are now furious, but there's not much they can do to act upon it."

29.speaker: Player
29.text: “It's not my favorite idea, but if it helps with the election, I guess I have no choice."

31.speaker: Gloria Tory
31.text: “With a key difference: Orso was smarter. This could still prove to be positive.”

34.speaker: Gloria Tory
34.text: “Mr. Holl has reported to me that he is currently putting the finishing touches on his new economic plan."

35.speaker: Gloria Tory
35.text: “He said he wanted to solidify the plan before it is presented to you.”

36.speaker: Gloria Tory
36.text: “He will schedule a meeting soon to go over our options.”

37.speaker: Player
37.text: “This better be good. For his own good.”

38.speaker: Player
38.text: “Tell him to be quick. Our administration depends on it.”

39.speaker: Player
39.text: “Symon can pull it off, I'm sure. He has never failed me before.”

40.speaker: Player
40.text: “I will be expecting good ideas and even better outcomes.”

169.text: “I have some updates from the Assembly.”

170.speaker: Gloria Tory
170.text: “I'm sure you were aware that the PFJP has been struggling to cope with the... absence of Frens Ricter."

171.speaker: Gloria Tory
171.text: “Without a leader, they've been scrambling to keep the party intact.”

172.speaker: Gloria Tory
172.text: “Or at least, that was the case until yesterday's PFJP congress.”

175.speaker: Gloria Tory
175.text: “They've elected a relatively untested member of their ranks as the new leader."

177.speaker: Gloria Tory
177.text: “I don't know how she made it into the highest ranks of the PFJP, but one thing is for sure.”

178.speaker: Gloria Tory
178.text: “She is popular both in the Assembly and among the people. She also happens to have quite a large female following."

181.speaker: Player
181.text: “What can she do when Frens couldn't do anything?”

183.speaker: Player
183.text: “Don't be alarmed. We have nothing to worry about.”

193.speaker: Gloria Tory
193.text: “As one of the most enthusiastic Young Sords members, he was recruited by Kesaro himself during the coup when he was still in the military.”

194.speaker: Gloria Tory
194.text: “Not the most charming fellow I've ever met.”

195.speaker: Gloria Tory
195.text: “Some say that he might be even more extreme than Kibener in his hardline anti-Bludish sentiments.”

196.speaker: Player
196.text: "I'd say it's time for the 'Iron Wall' to come down.”

201.speaker: Gloria Tory

202.speaker: Gloria Tory
202.text: “As much as I don't like either of them, you are right.”

204.speaker: Gloria Tory

211.text: "The indefinitely delayed case of Ishval Ersen against Governor Phelix Bron has finally reached to a conclusion."

215.speaker: Gloria Tory

216.speaker: Gloria Tory
216.text: "I must say... He already gave a landmark ruling as his first act."

220.speaker: Gloria Tory
220.text: "He was found guilty of abusing his powers to enable discrimination against the citizens of Sordland which directly goes against the new Constitution. He was therefore found guilty of breaking the constitutional laws of the state."

221.speaker: Gloria Tory
221.text: "He was promptly stripped from his duties as governor of the Special Zone and was sent directly to Antel Rock Prison."

222.speaker: Gloria Tory
222.text: "As for his replacement, the Court argued that since it was an extraordinary circumstance and the elections are already nearby, a transitionary council must take charge of the governance of the Special Zone."

223.speaker: Gloria Tory
223.text: "According to the decisions made in that council, Ishval Ersen was already picked as the most suitable governor choice, arguably as a Bludish rights activist from Bergia who became extremely famous for bringing up the issues to the governmental level."
